game.q: the court has to rule. whose swan is it?

wrong.swan: the swan agrees. the court went another way.

game.right: YES. a life belongs to the one who saves it, not the one who tries to take it.

end.line: one boy shot the swan. the other saved it, won it, and let it fly.

cliff.s2: he builds his son three palaces, one for every season, so he’ll never want to leave.
